# PlinkMatrix: DelayedArray interface for plink genotypes

<div class="section level1">

Given a collection of .bed, .bim and .fam files produced for use with
Plink, this package facilitates simple array-like operations for
retrieving genotype data.

As an example, the GEUVADIS study genotypes distributed with tensorQTL
were transformed to `geuv445.{bed,bim,fam}`. In a folder containing
these files, we would proceed as follows to interrogate the genotypes.

    > library(PlinkMatrix)
    > gdemo = example_PlinkMatrix()
    > colnames(gdemo) = gsub("0_", "", colnames(gdemo))
    > gdemo
    <367759 x 445> DelayedMatrix object of type "double":
                            HG00096 HG00097 HG00099 ... NA20826 NA20828
        chr18_10644_C_G_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_10847_C_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11275_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11358_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11445_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
                        ...       .       .       .   .       .       .
    chr18_80259028_AG_A_b38       1       2       2   .       0       1
     chr18_80259147_G_C_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
     chr18_80259181_A_G_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
       chr18_8025919C_G_b38       1       0       0   .       1       0
     chr18_80259245_C_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0

The associated data can be obtained in this package with
`example_PlinkArray()`.

See “Get started” tab above for more information.

</div>

</div>

<div id="main" class="col-md-9" role="main">

# Package index

<div class="section level2">

## All functions

</div>

<div class="section level2">

-   `PlinkMatrix()` : Constructor for DelayedArray
-   `PlinkSeed-class` : Define the PlinkSeed class
-   `PlinkSeed()` : Constructor function for seed for plink bed format
-   `decode_bed_genotypes()` : Helper function to decode BED format
-   `dim(<PlinkSeed>)` : Method: dim for delayed plink
-   `dimnames(<PlinkSeed>)` : Method: dimnames for delayed plink
-   `example_GRanges` : sample GRanges coordinated with
    example\_PlinkMatrix
-   `example_PlinkMatrix()` : produce PlinkMatrix from example data
-   `extract_array(<PlinkSeed>)` : Method: extract\_array, internal
-   `g445samples` : sample characteristics of 445 GEUVADIS samples
-   `getSampleData()` : Get sample metadata
-   `getVariantData()` : Get variant metadata
-   `get_plink_example_path()` : operate with BiocFileCache to retrieve
    zip file of plink example data
-   `plid2gr()` : produce GRanges from variant notation for plink
    example from geuvadis
-   `read_bed_subset()` : read subset for use in delayed matrix approach
-   `show(<PlinkSeed>)` : present seed concisely

</div>

</div>
